_comment: ERAN v1 config -- DGX 4 fast path. SAME model dims as config.json so it RESUMES the same Eran from checkpoints/latest.pt; only the training loop is opened up (no mic competes on the DGX).
_data_comment: Voice-only corpus, built live by data.py. NEVER a book corpus.
_paths_comment: Relative paths so this config works on the Linux DGX too (dgx4_launch.sh cd's into eran-live first). The checkpoint + voice corpus must be present on the DGX -- see report. fleet_status_path points at a sibling fleet/ checkout.

gpu._comment: vram_fraction 0 = no cap (dedicated DGX). step_sleep_ms 0 = full throttle. batch_size is PER-GPU; DDP multiplies by nproc_per_node.
